svg.title: As agentic sessions grow turn by turn, BF16 KV runs out and latency jumps; FP8 KV holds
svg.desc: Left: one session's prompt grows from 2,601 tokens at turn 0 to 8,207 at turn 7, because every turn re-sends the 2,000-token shared prompt and the whole history. Right: at 256 concurrent sessions on TP8+EP8, per-turn TTFT p90 and ITL p90. With BF16 KV (906,304-token pool) TTFT p90 jumps from 8.83 s at turn 4 to 28.4 s at turn 5 and ITL p90 passes 150 ms. With FP8 KV (1,812,224-token pool) both stay flat: TTFT p90 2.09 s to 5.09 s, ITL p90 43 to 59 ms.
svg.text: Sessions grow every turn; at 256 sessions BF16 KV runs out mid-session
TP8+EP8, 256 concurrent agentic sessions; same flags except the KV cache dtype; both runs finished every planned turn

g.text: Measured KV peak: 1.00 of the BF16 pool (it filled), 0.70 of the FP8 pool (it never filled). Same layout, same 2,208 turns.

svg.text: Per-turn p90 over all requests at that turn index (n = 256 at t0 to 130 at t8). FP8 KV used an uncalibrated scale, so output quality is not verified.
Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 FP8 | 8x H100 SXM5 | Dynamo 1.6.0 + vLLM 0.31.0 | single runs
